title: mammillaria micrantha
intro: Mammillaria micrantha, commonly known as the Small Flowered Pincushion Cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a therapeutic option for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mammillaria micrantha include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, it has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues.
